title: CVE-2026-85215 — SQL Injection in GG Soft's Paperwork
summary: Affected: GG Soft Software Services Inc. Paperwork Improper neutralization of special elements used in an SQL command ('SQL injection') vulnerability in GG Soft Software Services Inc. Paperwork allows SQL Injection. This issue affects Paperwork: through 2026-09-09.

title: CVE-2026-85209 — IDOR in AVEZ Electronics's LMS
summary: Affected: AVEZ Electronics Communication Training and Consultancy Trade Inc. Learning Management System (LMS) Missing Authorization vulnerability in AVEZ Electronics Communication Training and Consultancy Trade Inc. Learning Management System (LMS) allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels. This issue affects Learning Management System (LMS): through 2026-09-18.

title: CVE-2026-80464 — API Tool Runner SSRF in HAVELSAN's Sef - AI Chatbot Platform
summary: Affected: HAVELSAN Inc. Sef - AI Chatbot Platform Server-Side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in HAVELSAN Inc. Sef - AI Chatbot Platform allows Server Side Request Forgery. This issue affects Sef - AI Chatbot Platform: before 2.1. NOTE: The vendor was contacted and it was learned that the product is not supported.

title: CVE-2026-80443 — Insecure TLS Certificate Validation in API Tool Runner in HAVELSAN's  Sef - AI Chatbot Platform
summary: Affected: HAVELSAN Inc. Sef - AI Chatbot Platform Improper certificate validation vulnerability in HAVELSAN Inc. Sef - AI Chatbot Platform allows Adversary in the Middle (AiTM). This issue affects Sef - AI Chatbot Platform: before 2.1. NOTE: The vendor was contacted and it was learned that the product is not supported.

title: CVE-2026-80337 — Unauthorized Cross-Chatbot Tool Invocation in HAVELSAN's Sef - AI Chatbot Platform
summary: Affected: HAVELSAN Inc. Sef - AI Chatbot Platform Missing Authorization vulnerability in HAVELSAN Inc. Sef - AI Chatbot Platform allows Accessing Functionality Not Properly Constrained by ACLs. title: CVE-2026-11795 — User Enumeration in Softtr's E-Commerce Pack
summary: Affected: Softtr Informatics Trading Limited Company E-Commerce Pack Observable discrepancy vulnerability in Softtr Informatics Trading Limited Company E-Commerce Pack allows Account Footprinting. This issue affects E-Commerce Pack: through 2026-10-02. NOTE: The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

title: CVE-2026-96990 — Apache Thrift: Erlang thrift_json_protocol reads a whole message with no size bound
summary: Affected: Apache Software Foundation Apache Thrift Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling vulnerability in Apache Thrift Erlang bindings. This issue affects Apache Thrift: before 0.25.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.25.0, which fixes the issue.

title: CVE-2026-96294 — Apache Thrift: nodejs web server: no `error` listener on an upgraded WebSocket connection
summary: Affected: Apache Software Foundation Apache Thrift Uncaught exception, Improper Handling of Exceptional Conditions vulnerability in Apache Thrift NodeJS bindings. This issue affects Apache Thrift: before 0.25.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.25.0, which fixes the issue.

title: CVE-2026-96292 — Apache Thrift: Lua `THttpTransport:_parseHeaders` matches each header line with a backtracking pattern (quadratic)
summary: Affected: Apache Software Foundation Apache Thrift Inefficient regular expression complexity, Inefficient Algorithmic Complexity vulnerability in Apache Thrift Lua bindings. This issue affects Apache Thrift: before 0.25.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.25.0, which fixes the issue.
